summary: Execution chain step B done: an information-safe live TextArena SecretMafia runner exists, plays complete self-play episodes for all four SCK variants, and passes 7 live tests against textarena 0.7.4.
round_goal: Implement an information-safe live TextArena SecretMafia runner that consumes only the current actor's legal visible observation/transcript and can complete a full episode.
changed: narrative/longform/storybox_textarena_secret_mafia_live_v0.py (new): actor-visible ActorView boundary, transcript plumbing, explicit behavior evidence model, plain/memory/belief/belief_planning policies, live runner, truth-only-in-evaluation scoring (Brier, action regret, leakage).
runtime/adaptation/storybox/sck-head-v1.json: live runner recorded as implemented_and_executed with its environment and command; capabilities updated; environment_constraints section added.

information_boundary_evidence.runtime_guard: assert_information_safe runs on every decision view and raises if a backstage attribute is present or if the boundary object carries a pending night elimination.
information_boundary_evidence.static_audit: test_policy_and_runner_sources_never_read_backstage_state_before_evaluation parses the module AST and asserts that no audited decision-path definition reads player_roles, secret_roles or pending_elimination. evaluate_episode is the only exempt definition, and the single allowed read is the guard's own 'is None' check, listed explicitly.
information_boundary_evidence.empirical_audit: test_live_actor_views_only_ever_carry_the_actors_own_private_prompt wraps the policy during a real episode and asserts every view contains exactly one PROMPT observation, its own, and no other player's role text.
information_boundary_evidence.truth_use: player_roles, rewards, game_info and the pending night elimination are read only in evaluate_episode, after all decisions are recorded.

live_properties_verified: all four variants complete a full 6-player episode and produce win/utility, action regret and leakage numbers
belief variants produce real Brier/calibration checkpoints; plain and memory have no belief so Brier is reported as None rather than fabricated
episodes are deterministic for a fixed seed (identical roles, step count, reason and rewards)
information leakage count is zero for every variant
Doctor decisions exist and their oracle uses the evaluation-only pending night target

findings: textarena 0.7.4 scrubs role tags from every PLAYER_ACTION message via State.add_observation, so structured votes arrive as the empty string. Vote targets are UNOBSERVABLE, which invalidates the vote-based evidence model sketched in sck-secret-mafia-ab-v0.json and in the adapter's recorded_vote_evidence helper. Evidence must come from GAME_MESSAGE events.

The remaining live evidence events are: night kill, 'No one was killed tonight', vote elimination, and the Detective's private result. The Mafia's own team list is legitimate private knowledge from its prompt.
game_state['day_number'] is never incremented by the environment, so the runner keeps its own night counter.
SecretMafiaEnv.reset seeds the global random module, so policies must use their own random.Random instance or they silently perturb environment randomness. The runner enforces this per policy.

At 6 players the actionable public evidence is thin: a night kill only excludes an already-dead candidate, so it does not discriminate among the living. The belief advantage is expected to concentrate on Mafia-side play (never eliminate a teammate) and on the Detective's own hard result, not on village voting.
limits: Every seat is driven by the same policy, so episodes are SCK self-play; the A/B measures self-play quality, not strength against a fixed external opponent.
Discussion uses a deterministic template renderer, not an LLM. It cannot persuade, so persuasion_delta is reported unavailable and communication_separated currently has no causal effect.
BehaviorEvidenceModel likelihoods are hand-specified, not learned or replay-calibrated.
Only 6-player games were exercised in tests; 8 and 10 players from the benchmark plan are untested.
The runner is noncanonical and writes nothing back to the frozen historical ledger.
next_gate: Execution chain step C: build the shared-seed A/B harness and run the 50-episode smoke test across plain, memory, belief and belief_planning, reporting win/utility, per-role results, Brier/calibration, action regret and leakage with unavailable metrics marked unavailable.
action_required: No reply needed. Step C is starting in the same chain; the next bus message will carry the measured A/B numbers.
